title: Amendment during the final draft — the abort loses the race
notes: The amendment lands while the worker is already drafting, so the abort
arrives too late and that worker finishes and reports anyway.
Version gating ignores the superseded result. Run with
--no-version-gate to watch it reach the chat instead.
